At Tat Sat Universe, each crystal product is energetically tuned, blessed, and activated for you through our Trinity Healing Ritual - a sacred process that includes light codes, sound frequencies, and fire-based activation. Because of this, our pieces are not interchangeable or reassignable once they’ve been customized.

Please read the following policy carefully before placing your order.

Returns, Refunds & Exchanges

1. No Returns or Exchanges

Due to the deeply personal energetic preparation of each Tat Sat product, we do not accept any returns or exchanges.

Every crystal goes through a sacred Trinity Healing ritual intended specifically for you. Once activated, that piece cannot and should not be reassigned to another soul.

We request you to:

  • Recheck your bracelet size before ordering
  • Reach out to us if you're unsure about your choice before placing the order — we're here to help.
2. Incorrect Size or Change of Mind

We are unable to accommodate requests for changes in size, design, or intention post-purchase due to the irreversible energy work performed on each item.

Damaged or Incorrect Items

While we do not offer returns, we do support replacements in the rare case of:

  • Wrong item received
  • Product damaged during transit

To qualify:

  • You must share an unboxing video as proof
  • Email us at info@tatsatuniverse.com within 24 hours of delivery
  • Include your order number and a brief description of the issue

If validated, we will offer:

  • Credit points or a free replacement order (shipping included)

Need Help?

We’re here to support your journey.

For any queries related to your order, delivery, or product energy alignment, reach out to: 📧 info@tatsatuniverse.com

Thank you for honoring the energy.

At Tat Sat, we believe. Every product you receive is not just an object - it’s a living field of intention, light, and sacred healing.


Hari Om Tat Sat
The Ultimate Truth
